gold_definition: full result-set re-execution of each CQ's reference Cypher against the released per-WG graph; no LLM in the gold path. Gold = canonicalised SET of the query's primary (first) return column plus its row_count.
held_policy: CQs whose gold is empty or uniformly zero/false on the released graph (entity-layer constructs not materialised in the operational graph, or genuinely-empty answer sets) are held out of the scored set to avoid degenerate set-scoring; they ship with their Cypher and gold_status/row_count under held/ but carry no scored gold values.
note: gold/ ships the full AUTHORED superset (one file per WG) as the benchmark's build input and provenance. The RELEASED-and-scored subset is benchmark.jsonl (self-contained, embeds gold values). authored = released + held.
